About me

I'm a Nigerian tech content creator and mobile photographer passionate about creative storytelling and technology.

I'm largely self-taught and constantly experiment with new tools, techniques and ideas to improve my work in content creation, photography, cinematography and video editing.

I'm driven by curiosity, creativity and the desire to turn what I learn into meaningful content.
